title: 2026 UK CBAM return and payment QA controls

sources.title: Carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM): Policy Summary
Prepare for the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)

facts.source_fact: A registrable person must submit a CBAM tax return after each accounting period until deregistration conditions are met.
facts.expected_handling: Track return duty by accounting period.

facts.source_fact: A return is still required for an accounting period with nil CBAM liability.
The first CBAM accounting period runs from 1 January to 31 December 2027.
facts.expected_handling: Treat the first period as annual.

facts.source_fact: The first return and payment deadline is 31 May 2028.
From 1 January 2028, CBAM accounting periods move to a quarterly cycle.
Multiple consignments of the same CBAM good are reported separately.
Different CBAM goods in the same shipment are reported separately.
Return information includes commodity code, net weight, emissions intensity, qualifying carbon price where applicable, and origin information.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve required return fields and units.

facts.source_fact: HMRC lists Direct Debit, BACS/CHAPS, PISP, Faster Payment, cards and cheques as accepted payment methods.
facts.expected_handling: Treat payment method as administration, not emissions evidence.

facts.source_fact: A return can be amended within 3 years of the end of the accounting period, with evidence retained for corrections or repayments.

guard_patterns.handling: Bind obligations to the correct accounting period.
Preserve code, kg, tCO2e intensity and GBP fields.
Do not treat payment records as emissions measurements.
Flag period, field or amendment conflicts.
